votes.motion: Approve the appointments of Robert Croteau and Bruce Walker as Public Weighers (at Keatings).
votes.quote: mr. ebersole moved to approve the appointments of robert croteau and bruce walker as public weighers (at keatings). ms. bertram seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the nomination of Shirley Bertone, Tony Bertone, and Judith Tarbell to the Council on Aging.
votes.quote: mr. toale moved to approve the nomination of shirley bertone, tony bertone, and judith tarbell to the council on aging. ms. bertram seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the violation findings as presented by the Chair (four violations against B & H Corporation).
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to approve the violation findings as presented by the chair. mr. matthews seconded.

votes.motion: Suspend the liquor license of B&H Corporation d/b/a Mickey Shea's from serving alcohol on Friday October 18, 2013 and Saturday October 19, 2013.
votes.quote: mr. matthews moved to suspend the license of b&h corporation d/b/a mickey shea's to serve alcohol on friday october 18, 2013 and saturday october 19, 2013. mr. toale seconded.

votes.motion: Approve all of the Earth Removal Permits identified by the Town Manager.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to approve all of the earth removal permits identified by the town manager matthews seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.
being no further business ms. bertram moved to adjourn the meeting. mr. matthews seconded.
